description: antaresViz is an R package for exploring output from Antares electricity-system simulations. Its README says it takes tables already imported with the separate antaresRead package and provides time-series, distribution and cumulative plots, including an interactive Shiny widget. Users supply Antares result tables; outputs are visual summaries for selected areas, links or variables. Geographic coverage and time horizon follow the upstream Antares study. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing. A limitation is that the visualisation package does not run or validate the underlying dispatch simulation; wrong input mappings or old scenario assumptions can still produce plausible plots. It can help examine congestion, price and generation differences across electricity infrastructure scenarios. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model is a distinct optimisation engine. No Antares outputs or R package were downloaded.
name: antaresViz Antares simulation visualiser
